lead: Indiana plumbing deals with cold winters, basements, hard water and flooding. PipeMend sends licensed local plumbers across the state.
risk: frozen pipes, flooded basements and hard water scale
risk_short: frozen pipes, flooding and hard water
why: Many Indiana homes have basements, so sump pumps and basement water heaters are common. Hard water scales up water heaters and fixtures in much of the state.

Winters freeze pipes, and heavy rain floods basements and backs up sewers. Older homes in Indianapolis, Fort Wayne and Evansville have cast-iron drains and old sewer laterals. The Indiana Plumbing Commission licenses plumbers.
tips: Test your sump pump before spring.
areas: Calls come from Indianapolis, Fort Wayne, Evansville, South Bend, Carmel, Fishers, Bloomington and rural Indiana.

faq.a: The Indiana Plumbing Commission, through the Professional Licensing Agency, licenses plumbers. Check the license before work starts.
